text:
sophie_marketing: Quick sync — Q2 GTM plan for PLG activation + sales enablement. Need to align targets, launch milestones, and experiment slate. Who can triage scope and owners for enablement assets?

raj_sales: I can own sales targets and battlecards. High-level suggestion: aim for 25% MRR growth from PLG motion this quarter. Need product to confirm feature gating and timeline.

emily_pm: Product can commit to a limited feature-flag rollout: conversion funnel analytics + trial-to-paid CTA in-product. Proposed mid-April for initial gated rollout. We should prioritize a clear onboarding checklist in docs.

li_eng: Engineering note: gated CTA + basic funnel events = ~2 sprints. Need feature flags, rollout policy, and a quick KV-cache migration window. Mid-April is doable if scope stays narrow.

maria_ops: For Dedicated/Enterprise, we need separate comms and enablement (capacity, SSO, SLAs). Recommend parallel play with enterprise AE enablement.

sophie_marketing: Proposed milestones: experimental PLG funnel start 2026-04-15 (pilot), full push 2026-05-15. Marketing will own email nurture + in-product nudges + blog. Sales needs 3 battlecards, one short deck, and 2 play scripts.

raj_sales: I'll draft the battlecards. Need one on pricing objections, one on security/Private deployment, one on performance/cost tradeoffs. Who can own objections content? @tom_revops?

tom_revops: I can do pricing cheat sheet and quick formulas (seat vs usage). Will include a 1-page comparison and an objection FAQ. Delivery by 2026-04-01.

emily_pm: Launch criteria proposal: 1) Pilot conversion >= 4% trial->paid OR 2) NRR uplift > 2% in pilot cohort. Plus zero critical reliability incidents for 7 days post-full push.

li_eng: Reliability guardrails: canary in one region, automatic fallback to older model variant, rate-limited onboarding waves. I'll draft rollout RFC and the fallback policy. ETA 2026-03-25.

deploy-bot: Meeting scheduled: Q2 PLG kickoff — 2026-03-22 10:00am PT — https://calendar.company/meet/PLG-Q2-kickoff (automated)

sophie_marketing: Action items recap:
- @raj_sales: battlecards by 2026-03-28
- @tom_revops: pricing cheat sheet by 2026-04-01
- @li_eng: rollout RFC + fallback policy by 2026-03-25
- @emily_pm: confirm metrics dashboard (events + cohort view) by 2026-04-05
- @maria_ops: enterprise enablement outline by 2026-03-30

Also, @raj_sales can you confirm the baseline MRR so we have a concrete target number?

raj_sales: Confirming baseline MRR = $1.2M. 25% growth => +$300k ARR/MRR impact target for Q2 PLG motion. I'll share the spreadsheet later today.

sophie_marketing: Great — I'll draft the enablement timeline and example email templates, share a first cut by EOD Friday. :rocket: 

li_eng: One more ask from infra: if we enable caching/quantization to save cost on PLG traffic, we need an ops rollout note. @maria_ops can you own ops communications for that?

maria_ops: Yep, I'll own ops comms and release notes for Dedicated customers. Will coordinate with legal for tenant messaging.

sophie_marketing: Perfect. If no objections, I'll lock these milestones and spin up a public project board for visibility. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
